question.text: In case of simultaneous change of Sponsor/Manager AND change in control of Sponsor/Manager of a Cat III AIF, what is the fee payable to SEBI?

answer.text: Two separate fees of Rs. 15 lakh each
A single fee of Rs. 15 lakh

explanation.text: The Logic: Prior SEBI approval is required for change of Sponsor/Manager or change in control of the Sponsor/Manager of a Cat III AIF, and attracts a fee equivalent to the Category III AIF registration fee. Where both changes occur simultaneously, a single fee of Rs. 15 lakh is levied. The Trap: Two separate fees of Rs. 15 lakh are not charged; Rs. 10 lakh is not the prescribed amount; a fee IS payable. Note: The single-fee treatment applies only when the change of Sponsor/Manager and change in control of the Sponsor/Manager are simultaneous.
